page.overview:
Who is Asavar Kul?

Asavar Kul (pronounced "AZ-vaar Kul"), called "the Anointed", was a mighty Chaos Lord, High Zar of the Kurgans and the twelfth Everchosen of Chaos Undivided. In the year 2301 IC, he led the largest Chaos horde assembled at that time, laying waste to the lands of northern Kislev.

After defeating a joint Kislevite and Ostlander army, the horde made for the Kislevite cities of Praag and Erengrad, capturing the former and sacking the latter. Soon the capital city of Kislev itself fell under siege. Kul's horde was ultimately repulsed and broken by the combined Imperial armies of Magnus the Pious, the defenders of Kislev and Dwarfs from Karaz-a-Karak, in what was known as the Great War Against Chaos. Kul was slain in the conflict at the Battle at the Gates of Kislev, and after his death his demoralised and disorganised armies were ground down by the victorious defenders.

The Chaos Wastes are a place polluted with evil sorcery. It is a nightmarish landscape from which hordes of bloodthirsty marauders, iron-clad warriors and Champions of Chaos, mutant monsters, and vile Daemons launch their attacks upon the mortal world. This war-wracked land lies far to the north of the Empire. However, when the Winds of Magic blow strongly, the Realm of Chaos expands; the Northern Wastes are swallowed up and the armies of Chaos pour down through Troll Country into Kislev and the Empire. The furthest the Chaos Wastes have ever expanded southwards in the history of the Empire was during the Great War Against Chaos, which began in the year 2301 IC.

Having risen to prominence among the northern barbarian tribes over many years, Asavar Kul was the most powerful champion of the Dark Gods to have ascended in an age. With his nightmarish armies finally united, he moved southwards, fuelled by the growing tide of Chaos. Daemons moved with them, sustained by fresh tides of life-giving magic, and warherds of Beastmen rampaged unchecked through the forests. In the heartlands of the Empire, evil sorcerers and worshippers of the Chaos Gods emerged from their secret conclaves to attack Human society from within. As winter engulfed the Old World, the Chaos armies struck. The northern lands of Kislev were quickly overwhelmed.
